test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of speech for the given sentence.

Bajrang said, “I went to Chandigarh yesterday.”

options.text: Bajrang said that he had gone to Chandigarh the day before.
Bajrang said that he was gone to Chandigarh the day before.
Bajrang said that he gone to Chandigarh the day before.
Bajrang said that he have gone to Chandigarh the day before.

solution:
The correct answer is:Bajrang said that he had gone to Chandigarh the day before.
